full_judgment: 5. With regard to the defendant's application under Order 7 rule 11 of the Code, it appears that the same was filed on 28-9-77. The application which ought to have been heard and disposed of as a preliminary issue was kept pending and disposed of along with the other two applications filed by the plaintiffs and Mariam Khatun on 8-11-77. Be that as it may, the defendant's application was filed on the ground that the plaint did not disclose any cause of action. Plaintiffs had filed the suit on the clear allegation that they were the real owners in possession of the suit property and the plaintiff No. 2 as P. W. 1 had also Asserted the same on oath before the court on 27-9-77. It was stated in the application under Order 7 rule 11 of the Code that during the pendency of the suit the plaintiffs had executed and registered a Muktinama dated 13-4-76 relinquishing and disclaiming all right, title and possession in the suit property in favor of one Mariam Khatun. The said relinquishment was re-affirmed in a compromise decree passed on 23-3-77 in Title Suit No. 117 of 1975 between Mariam Khatun as plaintiff and the present plaintiffs as defendants No. 1 and 2.
